findings.detail: GitHub PR #739 (draft) body still cites exact head ebebd9c025021cfbf650cc061c29e256397402dd and says 'paged touch is claimed only when selection geometry is already loaded'. The exact head c89734d6 REMOVES claimsTouch; README and CHANGELOG at this head correctly describe native touch navigation. The PR body was not updated for the new head.

A cold blank press is ignored by lumia-paged-drag (zero step calls). At Fit Width it stays on the page and Stage pans (12 -> 132 CSS px). With no pan room (Fit Page), EmbedPDF's own Stage turn stream can still advance the page (S6b reached readingPage 3). This matches the head's documented intent ('stays with text selection or Stage pan'), but 'drag before load is ignored' means ignored by this handler, not a guaranteed visual no-op.

getComputedStyle(.viewport).touchAction is 'none' from EmbedPDF's Stage inline style, unchanged by this PR. Native pan/pinch here means EmbedPDF's own synthesized gesture controller (one-finger pan/fling, two-finger pinch), both verified working. touchstart/touchmove were never defaultPrevented and the hub recorded zero touch gestures.
This head adds no Playwright browser spec. The temporary /tmp spec is behavioral proof only; persistent regressions are unit tests plus the VS Code host-GUI spec (not run here by instruction).
No product defect found in the 8 pointer scenarios; all pageErrors arrays were empty.
